Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = uid),
		copy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		copy.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		User.allInstance()->includes(user) and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(copy) and
		user.UserID = uid and
		copy.Barcode = barcode
	postcondition:
		let success: Boolean = true in
		let loan: Loan in
		loan.oclIsNew() and
		loan.LoanedUser = user and
		loan.LoanedCopy = copy and
		user.LoanedBook->includes(loan) and
		loan.ReturnDate = null and
		loan.IsReturned = false and
		loan.OverDueFee = 0.0 and
		result = success
}
